name: Yersin Museum
kicker: The doctor’s rooms in the Pasteur Institute
summary: Pasteur museum on Trần Phú: see Yersin’s rooms in 30 to 45 minutes for the doctor’s life in the city. It opens 07:30–11:30 and 14:00–17:00 from Monday through Saturday morning, at 26,000 VND. Saturday afternoon, Sunday, and public holidays are closed. The room is about 100 m², inside the institute at number 10.
dotReason: A short museum on the beach road, worth the hour beside a swim, not the reason for the city.
getThere: Inside the Pasteur Institute at 10 Trần Phú.
heroCaption: The museum doors, lettered Bảo tàng Yersin and Musée Yersin

notice.title: Closed Sunday and Saturday afternoon
notice.body: The ward page opens the museum Monday through Saturday morning, 07:30–11:30 and 14:00–17:00, and closes it Saturday afternoon, Sunday, and public holidays.

body: The museum is the small gallery inside the Pasteur Institute on Trần Phú, about 100 m². Allow 30 to 45 minutes. You are here for Alexandre Yersin’s working life in Nha Trang: letters, instruments, and the plain room set up as his reading and resting space, bed included.

The ward page of 26 April 2026 puts the door at 10 Trần Phú and the ticket at 26,000 VND a person. Hours are 07:30–11:30 and 14:00–17:00 from Monday through Saturday morning. Saturday afternoon, Sunday, and public holidays are closed. He set up the Nha Trang laboratory in 1895. The provincial relic page calls the old library, at number 8 on that page, the exhibition house the institute now treats as the museum.

figures.caption: The iron bed in the resting room
figures.alt: An iron bed and a chair in the Yersin Museum in Nha Trang

gettingThere: The museum is inside the Pasteur Institute on Trần Phú. The ward page gives number 10. The provincial relic page gives number 8 for the library that became the exhibition house. From a hotel on the beach road, walk along Trần Phú to the institute gate, then to the doors lettered Bảo tàng Yersin.

legs.heading: From Trần Phú
legs.body: Walk the beach road to the Pasteur Institute. The museum doors are inside the grounds.

legs.heading: From the station
legs.body: The station is in the centre. The institute is on Trần Phú, the beach road.

closed: Saturday afternoon, Sunday, and public holidays.
admissionNote: 26,000 VND a person, on the Nha Trang ward page of 26 April 2026. A 2008 finance decision set the same adult figure and 5,000 VND for students, pupils, and children. The 2026 ward page states only the 26,000 VND price.
